column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
libraries.test.ts: the manifest is read as data and never run, an unknown field and a second export are refused, and the check names where the manifest and its folder disagree
libraries.test.ts: the section of the libraries and the rows of enforcement.tsv are what the manifests make, and --check names the file that is not
affected.test.ts: the libraries a change affects by folder and by dependency, the inputs of a library, and the matrix a workflow reads
workflows.test.ts: the typed model, its validation findings and the rendering of the YAML, the same bytes for the same values
workflows.test.ts: the generator makes the files, finds a hand-written workflow and a missing packer, and the publish workflow tags a version that is already on the registry
pins.test.ts: the pins of an env file and the release asset of each platform; the installer is run by the workflows of this repository

the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; tests/release/commons-packages.test.ts packs every library of npm, refuses one with no declaration for an export and type-checks a consumer

mizan.test.ts, mizan-levels.test.ts, mizan-changes-git.test.ts and versions-git.test.ts, and in libraries mizan-oscal-register.test.ts and mizan-newer.test.ts: each command run on real folders and repositories
mizan-nist-import.test.ts: the committed module names the controls the specifications cite with the titles of the pinned catalog, and the offline check passes
the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; the commands run as bun commons/libraries/src/<command>.ts in the workflows of this repository

dev.test.ts: the counts and failures read from bun test, the packages a library installs itself, the libraries linked by name, what each scope affects, the summary, and a real run with a type error and a failing test
plan.test.ts: the cells on Linux and on the systems a library's record names, the outputs of a step, the command on this repository, and the one workflow ci
releasing.test.ts: each rule of the plan on facts, a breaking impact raising the minor while the major version is 0, and on a real repository with tags and commits

releasing.test.ts: apply refreshes the lockfiles, makes the generated files once, synchronizes, runs the proof last and writes the record, and publishes and tags nothing; release-lockfile.test.ts: on a real repository with a stale lockfile the gate passes after apply and fails without the refresh; matrix leaves out what is tagged
workflows.test.ts: the release workflow is by hand from main, in the order of the record, with provenance and the token only where there is one
family.test.ts: the family field is decoded, the reserved names are found as data with no folder, and each side of a family held against the host's table is found

readme.test.ts: the summary and the first clause are read as data, a row is made from each manifest, the table is sorted by role and name, a library with no role is a problem, --check writes nothing and fails where the README is stale, and the real README is what the manifests make
readme.test.ts: the real README has none of the words of history and every link to a path of the repository names a file or folder that exists
license.test.ts: --check writes nothing and names a missing or a hand-edited LICENSE, a changed official text is refused, the packer writes the SPDX id and packs the LICENSE
releasing.test.ts: the version is written into each constant the manifest names, and a missing file or constant is a sentence
libraries.test.ts: two libraries that hold one number are given one each, the first in the section keeping it
metapackages.test.ts: publishes and bundle are read, and the three refusals; releasing.test.ts: the release uses the package a manifest publishes
metapackages.test.ts: the members, the exact dependencies, the generator and its --check, the packer and the order in the plan
held.test.ts: the closed kinds, the refusals of the decoder, the distribution and the sets, the README row; metapackages.test.ts: a held library is not in the facts of a release

libraries.test.ts: a spec kit that docs.config.ts does not list is a finding naming the library and the line, a listed one is none; repoctl library-commit-doctor.test.ts: new library lists its spec kit
held.test.ts: the plan names each library that is not released with its kind and sentence, --raise of one is refused with its reason, and on a real repository the held library is out of the steps

release-floor.test.ts: the floor of removed and added keys, the greater of it and the commits wins, 0.x and 1.x, the reason in the plan, and on a real repository against a registry simulator that serves the manifest of a version

pack-commons.test.ts: the mode is one of two, the repository is in single mode, the environment names the other for one run and a value that is no mode is refused; tests/release/commons-packages.test.ts: the per-library machinery works again under IFC_DISTRIBUTION=per-library

pack-commons.test.ts: the exports of each library, the rewriting of specifiers, the union of dependencies, the commands, the files that do something when loaded, the runtime folders and the packer on the real files of a small repository; tests/release/commons-package.test.ts packs the real libraries

the one package is packed from the real libraries, inspected, installed with npm and with Bun, every entry imported on Node 26 and Bun, its commands run and a consumer type-checked with and without dom; pack-commons.test.ts shows each check that matters on a copy made to fail

pack-commons.test.ts: the tools of the package are derived from the manifests and the sources, a package the libraries need that the folder lacks is a finding, and the real folder is what the derivation makes; tests/release/commons-ci.test.ts: a fresh clone with only the folder installed packs the package

release-single.test.ts: single mode plans one release raised by the greatest Impact across the libraries, a held library counted, and the registries are github alone, the publication sending the tarball to the GitHub package registry and tagging
ci-findings.test.ts: the red causes are a closed list with their reasons and the release decision is a day's
ci-findings.test.ts: the id is stable, the status is derived from the runs and the acceptances
ci-findings.test.ts: each parser reads the real output of its tool
ci-findings.test.ts: the wrapper runs real processes and exits 0, and a wrong call is the one exit that is not
ci-policy.test.ts: every workflow keeps the policy, no step can end a job red but a red cause or a gate, and the validation finds what it is for
ci-collect.test.ts: the merge, the sound-pipeline check, the summary
ci-history.test.ts: a real repository, a file added and never replaced, a moved branch retried
ci-findings.test.ts: the release policy of a day
ci-accepted.test.ts: each rule of an acceptance is found in real files and a good one passes
registry-clean.test.ts: the selection of versions, its refusals and the program that deletes nothing
shard.test.ts: every file is in exactly one of the shards and the shards are balanced; the plan gives a sharded library its cells
shard.test.ts: a sharded cell carries its library and its slug; --list prints the files of the shard
